title: Destiny Classes
description: This project adds the three main classes and subclasses from the destiny games
body:
# Destiny Classes [BETA]
Become a Guardian in Minecraft 1.21. This mod introduces the three iconic classes from Destiny, each with distinct elemental subclasses and fully functional abilities.

## Choose Your Destiny
You can select your class and element at any time using the new GUI system.

### Inventory Button: 
Open your player inventory and click the new Class button to open the selection menu.

### The Ghost:
Use the Ghost item in-game to access the menu quickly.

## Classes and Abilities
Once you have selected a class and element, press the Ability Key (Default: G) to activate your power.

Titan - The Stallwart Defender

Solar: Throws the Hammer of Sol to damage enemies.

Arc: Launches a Thundercrash, propelling you forward and causing an explosion on impact.

Void: Activates Ward of Dawn, creating a protective dome and granting resistance.

Hunter - The Agile Scout

Solar: Throws an explosive Weighted Knife for high precision damage.

Arc: Performs Blink, a short-range teleport in the direction you are looking.

Void: Enters Vanishing Step, granting temporary invisibility and speed.

Warlock - The Arcane Warrior

Solar: Casts Well of Radiance, creating an area that heals you and your allies.

Arc: Fires a Chaos Reach lightning beam that damages entities in front of you.

Void: Launches a Nova Bomb, a slow-moving projectile with massive area-of-effect damage.

## Beta Information
This mod is currently in BETA for Minecraft 1.21. All core features are functional, but you may encounter minor visual bugs or balance issues. Feedback is appreciated as we continue to add new abilities and exotic gear.

## Requirements:

Fabric Loader

Fabric API

Inspired by Bungie's Destiny 2.
